title: White House Launches 24/7 'Trump TV' Streaming Channel Amid Press Ban Dispute
detail: The White House launched a round-the-clock YouTube livestream Monday night, September 21 into September 22, 2026, branded 'Trump TV: The Essentials Station,' days after President Trump announced he was banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from White House grounds. Deputy assistant to the president Kaelan Dorr described it as a '24/7 livestream of the Administration's greatest hits, unfiltered,' with the debut broadcast opening on Trump's July 3, 2026 Mount Rushmore speech and continuing with a loop of administration remarks, bill signings and public appearances rather than a conventional news schedule, hosts or live coverage. The launch came the same day the three banned outlets sued the administration and the White House television press pool halted coverage of Trump's events in protest; press-freedom advocates and Democratic lawmakers criticized the channel as 'state-run media.'

media.caption: The White House launched 'Trump TV: The Essentials Station,' a 24/7 YouTube livestream, days after banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico

title: Trump Tells UN General Assembly He Could 'Annihilate' Iran, Predicts Deal After Midterms
detail: Addressing the 81st UN General Assembly in New York on Tuesday, September 22, 2026, President Trump said he faced 'a big decision to make': either allow Iran to negotiate a deal that lets it 'rebuild and create a far greater country than it ever was before,' or 'annihilate the Islamic Republic, and do it quickly.' Trump predicted Tehran would not agree to terms until after the November midterm elections, saying 'I believe we'll make a deal right after the election because it doesn't make sense for them not to,' and suggested Iran was 'waiting to see how I do' at the polls. The remarks, delivered as the six-month-old US-Iran war continued, prompted a rebuke the following day from Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, who told the same chamber 'we will not bow our head' and displayed photos of children killed in the conflict while the sole US delegate present walked out of the speech.

media.caption: President Trump addresses the UN General Assembly, saying he could 'annihilate' Iran or let it 'rebuild' after a deal reached following the midterms
